title: Summer 2026: Truss & JobTread Integration
body_markdown:
Hi there,


Big one on the way. If you run your projects in JobTread, you'll soon be able to sync directly to Truss.


**🔗 Truss + JobTread, connected**
Connect once, and a Pay button appears on the estimates and invoices you send from JobTread.


**🚫 Skip the QuickBooks middle-step**


No more JobTread → QuickBooks → Truss. It's direct now — nothing to sync or reconcile just to get paid.


**💵 Your client pays in a click**


No portal link. The Pay button sits right on the JobTread invoice. One click to pay by bank (ACH) or card (3.25% + $0.30).


No exports. No double entry. No third tool.


[Learn more →](https://try.trusspayments.com/help/topic/integrations)
